quests.instruction: Both the short hand and the long hand point straight up at the 12. What time is it?
quests.hint: Each hand has its own job: one tells the hour and the other tells the minutes.
quests.explanation: The short hand on 12 shows the hour 12. The long hand on 12 shows 0 minutes. So the time is 12:00.
quests.funFact: At exactly 12 o'clock, the hour hand and the minute hand lie on top of each other.

quests.instruction: The toy clock face 🕐 shows a whole hour. What time is it?
quests.hint: Check which number the short hand points to. Be careful not to mix up 1 and 10.
quests.explanation: The long hand is on 12 and the short hand is on 1, so the time is 1:00.
quests.funFact: The first mechanical clocks, built in Europe about 700 years ago, had only an hour hand.

quests.instruction: Which time is the same as eleven o'clock?
quests.hint: Say the hour first, then think about how many extra minutes there are.
quests.explanation: Eleven o'clock is an exact hour: 11 hours and 0 minutes, written 11:00. The time 1:10 is ten minutes after one o'clock.
quests.funFact: Before mechanical clocks, people used water clocks that measured time by how fast water dripped from a bowl.

quests.instruction: The art club starts at 3:00 PM and the chess club starts at 5:00 PM. Which club starts earlier?
options: They start at the same time
quests.hint: Both times are in the afternoon. Which hour comes first on the clock?
quests.explanation: Both clubs are in the afternoon, and 3 comes before 5. So the art club starts earlier.
quests.funFact: In many places far from the equator, sunrise comes earlier in summer and later in winter.

quests.instruction: Which of these times is the latest?
quests.hint: All three are in the morning. Think about which one is closest to noon.
quests.explanation: In the same part of the day, a bigger hour means a later time. So 11:00 AM comes after 9:00 AM and 6:00 AM.
quests.funFact: Bakers and farmers often start work before sunrise, so their day begins very early.

quests.instruction: Mina's cricket practice ends at 6:00 PM. Dev's practice ends at 7:00 PM. Whose practice ends later?
options: They end at the same time
quests.hint: Later means further along in the day. Compare the two hours.
quests.explanation: Both practices end in the evening, and 7 comes after 6. So Dev's practice ends later.
quests.funFact: Going to sleep and waking up at about the same times each day helps the body keep a steady rhythm.

quests.instruction: Priya has a swimming lesson at 10:00 AM and a piano lesson at 2:00 PM. Which lesson comes first?
quests.hint: Check AM and PM before you compare the numbers.
quests.explanation: 10:00 AM is in the morning and 2:00 PM is in the afternoon. Morning comes first, so swimming is first.
quests.funFact: The word noon comes from a Latin word meaning "ninth hour". Long ago it meant mid-afternoon, and it slowly moved to midday.

quests.instruction: Which time is later: 11:00 AM or 1:00 PM?
quests.hint: The number 11 is bigger than 1, but AM and PM matter more.
quests.explanation: 11:00 AM is before noon. 1:00 PM is one hour after noon. So 1:00 PM is later, even though 1 is a smaller number than 11.
quests.funFact: When you compare times, look at AM and PM first, and only then at the numbers.

quests.instruction: Which time is the earliest in the day: 9:00 PM, 4:00 PM or 8:00 AM?
quests.hint: Sort the three times into morning, afternoon and night first.
quests.explanation: 8:00 AM is in the morning. 4:00 PM is in the afternoon and 9:00 PM is at night. So 8:00 AM is the earliest.
quests.funFact: Pocket watches, the first clocks small enough to carry, appeared about 500 years ago.

quests.instruction: Ravi's weekend plans are: a film at 6:00 PM, planting seeds at 11:00 AM, and feeding the ducks at 7:00 AM. Which event happens last?
quests.hint: Put the three times in order, from the morning to the night.
quests.explanation: 7:00 AM and 11:00 AM are both in the morning. 6:00 PM is in the evening, so the film is last.
quests.funFact: Historians use timelines to put events in order from earliest to latest.

quests.instruction: Which list shows the times in order, from earliest to latest?
quests.hint: Find the morning time first, then the middle of the day, then the afternoon time.
quests.explanation: 7:00 AM is in the morning, 12:00 PM is noon, and 5:00 PM is late afternoon. That is the correct order.
quests.funFact: Diaries and planners help people remember what comes first and what comes next.

quests.instruction: Ana's plans are: kite flying at 3:00 PM, painting at 9:00 AM, and bird watching at 6:00 PM. Which activity comes second?
quests.hint: Put the three times in order first, then pick the one in the middle.
quests.explanation: In time order the plans are painting at 9:00 AM, kite flying at 3:00 PM, then bird watching at 6:00 PM. So kite flying is second.
quests.funFact: A sundial works only when the sun is shining, which is one reason people invented other kinds of clocks.

quests.instruction: It is 4:00 PM. What time will it be one hour later?
quests.hint: Count one step forward on the clock face, starting from the 4.
quests.explanation: One hour later moves the hour hand forward by one number, from 4 to 5. It is still the afternoon, so the time is 5:00 PM.
quests.funFact: There are 60 minutes in an hour. Ancient Babylonians liked the number 60 because it can be divided in many ways.

quests.instruction: Eli's bus left at 9:00 AM. What time was it one hour before the bus left?
quests.hint: One hour before means one step backwards on the clock.
quests.explanation: One hour before moves the hour hand back by one number, from 9 to 8. It is still the morning, so the time was 8:00 AM.
quests.funFact: In one hour, the Earth turns about one twenty-fourth of a full turn.

quests.instruction: It is 11:00 AM. What time will it be 2 hours later?
quests.hint: After 11 the clock goes to 12, and then starts again at 1. What happens to AM and PM?
quests.explanation: Count two hours forward: 12:00 PM, then 1:00 PM. Passing noon changes AM to PM.
quests.funFact: Some countries move their clocks forward by one hour in spring to get more evening daylight.

quests.instruction: Hana wants to visit the library, which is open during the day. Which time is sensible for her visit?
quests.hint: Think about when most libraries are open and people are awake.
quests.explanation: At 10:00 AM it is daytime and libraries are open. At 10:00 PM and 3:00 AM it is dark and libraries are closed.
quests.funFact: Libraries and shops put their opening hours on the door, so checking them first saves a wasted trip.

quests.instruction: Which of these is NOT a sensible time for children to play football in the park?
quests.hint: Imagine the park at each time. Which one is the darkest and quietest?
quests.explanation: At 4:00 PM and 9:00 AM it is daylight and the park is busy. At 2:00 AM it is the middle of the night.
quests.funFact: Nocturnal animals, such as owls and bats, are active at night and rest during the day.

quests.instruction: Baby Noor takes a nap in the afternoon. Which time fits her nap?
quests.hint: Afternoon times come after noon.
quests.explanation: Afternoon times are PM times after noon, so 2:00 PM fits. 2:00 AM is the middle of the night and 8:00 AM is morning.
quests.funFact: Young children often rest in the afternoon, while older children usually do not need a nap.

quests.instruction: Which number is at the very bottom of a clock face?
quests.hint: The 12 is at the top. Which number is straight across from it?
quests.explanation: The 6 is directly opposite the 12, so it sits at the bottom of the clock face.
quests.funFact: Many old clocks use Roman numerals, and they often write the 4 as IIII instead of IV.

quests.instruction: At 9 o'clock, which side of the clock does the short hand point to?
quests.hint: Picture the 12 at the top and the 3 on the right. Where would the 9 be?
quests.explanation: The 3 is on the right side of the clock and the 9 is on the left side. So at 9 o'clock the short hand points left.
quests.funFact: Some clock faces have no numbers at all, only marks or dots, so you have to know where each number would be.

quests.instruction: At which o'clock time do the hands make a square corner, like the corner of a book?
quests.hint: Think about the two hands making an L shape.
quests.explanation: At 3:00 the long hand points up at 12 and the short hand points right at 3, making a square corner. At 6:00 the hands make a straight line, and at 12:00 they lie on top of each other.
quests.funFact: The word clock comes from an old word for a bell, because early clocks rang bells to tell the hour.

quests.instruction: Which time is between 2:00 PM and 6:00 PM?
quests.hint: Look for a time that is after 2:00 PM but before 6:00 PM.
quests.explanation: 4:00 PM comes after 2:00 PM and before 6:00 PM. 12:00 PM is before 2:00 PM and 8:00 PM is after 6:00 PM.
quests.funFact: Words like before, after and between appear in every timetable, so they are worth knowing well.

quests.instruction: Leo's plans are: reading at 5:00 PM, chess at 3:00 PM, and a visit to his grandmother at 4:00 PM. Which order is correct?
quests.hint: Write the times in order first: the earliest, then the next, then the latest.
quests.explanation: The times in order are 3:00 PM, 4:00 PM and 5:00 PM. That means chess, then the visit, then reading.
quests.funFact: Putting tasks in time order is the first step of making a good plan.

quests.instruction: Mira finishes painting at 11:00 AM. Which event could have happened before she finished?
quests.hint: Before means earlier on the clock than 11:00 AM.
quests.explanation: 9:00 AM is earlier than 11:00 AM, so the story session could happen before Mira finished. 1:00 PM and 3:00 PM come after 11:00 AM.
quests.funFact: Artists often paint in the morning because daylight is bright and clear.

quests.instruction: Which way of writing 4 o'clock in the afternoon is correct?
quests.hint: Afternoon times use PM.
quests.explanation: Afternoon times come after noon, so they are written with PM. 4:00 AM would be in the middle of the night, and 12:04 PM is just after noon.
quests.funFact: Writing AM or PM after a time helps people avoid turning up 12 hours early or late.

quests.instruction: A museum is open from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. At which time could you visit?
quests.hint: Your visit must be after the museum opens and before it closes.
quests.explanation: 2:00 PM is after the 9:00 AM opening and before the 5:00 PM closing. 7:00 AM is too early and 8:00 PM is too late.
quests.funFact: Reading opening hours before you go helps you arrive when a place is open.

quests.instruction: The pool sign says: Open 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM. Which time is the closing time?
quests.hint: Closing is when the opening hours end.
quests.explanation: The second time on the sign is when the pool closes. Opening hours start at 10:00 AM and end at 6:00 PM.
quests.funFact: Many outdoor pools close earlier in winter, when the days are shorter.

quests.instruction: The short hand is on 10, the long hand is on 12, and the sky outside is dark. Which time is it?
quests.hint: Read the hour from the short hand, then decide whether a dark sky points to AM or PM.
quests.explanation: The short hand on 10 and the long hand on 12 show 10 o'clock. A dark sky means night, so it is 10:00 PM. 12:10 AM comes from swapping the hands.
quests.funFact: Digital and analog clocks show the same time in two different ways, and good time readers can switch between them.

quests.instruction: Ms. Das's timetable says: 9:00 Art, 10:00 Music, 11:00 Science, 12:00 Reading. Which lesson starts one hour after Music starts?
quests.hint: Find Music on the timetable, then look at the next time.
quests.explanation: Music starts at 10:00. One hour later is 11:00, which is Science.
quests.funFact: Timetables list activities in time order, so you can read them from top to bottom like a story.

quests.instruction: Zoya sets two alarms, one for 6:00 AM and one for 6:00 PM. Which alarm rings first in a day?
options: They ring at the same time
quests.hint: Think about which comes first in a day: morning or evening.
quests.explanation: A day starts at midnight, and morning comes before evening. So the 6:00 AM alarm rings first.
quests.funFact: Check AM or PM when you set an alarm. A wrong setting can make it ring 12 hours late.
